lines.text: Many learners say: I am in the train now.
Better: I am on the train now.
With a train, we say on.
On! She is on the bus.

data.wrong: I am in the train now.
data.right: I am on the train now.
data.why: With a train, we say on.

native.tip: En français, on est « dans le train ». En anglais, on dit “on the train”.
